approval.rationale: Face-on rock-faced ashlar in even courses with thin dark joints at the 2 m tile scale; blocks vary in length and none repeats as a feature. In game it reads as dressed grey stone on the townhouse ground floors and the chapel.
limitations: The candidate is near-white limestone: the cook darkens (gain 0.6) and desaturates (0.62) it, so the blocks are even in tone and slightly flat.
Every block has the same pitched rock face; there is no weathering, soot or moss, so walls read clean at close range.
